title: Sightline catalogue product
description: Generated from src/catalog/schema.ts — do not edit by hand.

Txt.description: A bilingual text. Both languages are mandatory — `tx()` picks one.

Tags.description: Bilingual word lists: the search tags on a card.

Port.description: One connector as the data sheet lists it. `dir: "in"` is an uplink or a feed.

poe.description: PoE class this port hands out. `"af/at"` is a port that negotiates either.

Beam.description: Radiation pattern of an access point. `h: 360` is omnidirectional.

v.description: Vertical opening in degrees, where the vendor publishes one.

back.description: Rear lobe as a fraction of the main lobe, 0…1. An omni is 1.

Openness.description: How far a camera can be driven without the vendor's own console or app. A field that no data sheet confirmed is left out rather than guessed — "unknown" and "no" are different answers.

rtsp.description: `"via-console"`: only the vendor's recorder re-streams it.

cloud.description: `"required"`: nothing works without the vendor cloud.

Codecs.description: Video codecs per stream, lower-case tokens ("h264", "h265").

Links.description: Where to buy it. `vendor` is a path under the UniFi store or an absolute URL.

amazonSimilar.description: The Amazon link is an equivalent substitute, not the original item.

Specs.description: The numbers the planner computes with. Every field is optional here because one file serves four kinds; which ones a kind must carry is checked in tests/unit/catalog.test.ts.

res.description: "4K · 8 MP · 1/1.8\"" — "4K" in it counts as 4K for the NVR warning.

ir.description: Night-vision range in m; drives the cone radius.

fov.description: Opening in degrees; 360 means pan/tilt and is drawn as a circle.

zoom.description: Optical or hybrid zoom, as printed.

poe.description: How it is powered, as printed ("PoE+ (802.3at)").

out.description: Set explicitly, never guessed from `ip` — drives the mount row and the filters.

wifi.description: Camera: runs on Wi-Fi. Access point: the radio, as printed.

ports.description: Network ports on a device — conduit openings on a housing.

power.description: Active device: it needs a place of its own, not necessarily mains power.

dig.description: Goes into the ground; drives the select groups.

use.description: One line on the card: what the part is for.

sfp.description: Fibre plugs straight in — on a router this means LAN-side.

sfpPorts.description: SFP cages, read off the data sheet rather than counted from `ports`.

poePorts.description: What an injector passes on: it has two jacks and one downstream port.

extend.description: A PoE extender raises the copper limit of its run, in m.

poeDraw.description: Load on the feeder for a `powerIn: "poe"` device; 15 W when absent.

role.description: Exactly one entry per plan carries `"router"`.

qty.description: Default quantity when the item is switched on.

on.description: Preselected in a fresh plan — always false, the plan starts empty.

hidden.description: Kept out of the gear tab (switches sit on the map as elements).

sub.description: The subtitle under the name in the gear tab.

form.description: Junctions only: a place (`housing`) or something that goes into one (`device`).

vendor.description: `"any"` = vendor-neutral (shaft, box, cabinet); it passes every vendor filter.

status.description: Anything but `current` is hidden from the pickers unless "show deprecated" is on.

successor.description: The id that replaces this one. Only with a status other than `current`.

order.description: Sort key inside the kind, in steps of ten so something fits in between.

priceDate.description: When the price was last checked, `YYYY-MM`.

description.description: Two sentences for the card and the data sheet.

img.description: Image URL at the vendor. A local `image.webp` in the same folder wins.

powerIn.description: Where a device draws power from. Housings carry none.

ports.description: The connectors as the data sheet lists them.

poeIn.description: The PoE class the device itself accepts.
